title: A clinically validated 3D deep learning approach for quantifying vascular invasion in pancreatic cancer.
summary: PAN-VIQ segmented pancreatic tumors and five vessels on CT and quantified three-dimensional vessel encasement. It was trained and internally validated on 2,130 cases, externally validated with accuracy above 90%, and prospectively tested in 202 patients; it outperformed junior radiologists and matched senior radiologists in reported accuracy and recall.
